id.description: The unique identifier for the flow node

label.description: The label of the flow node

type.description: The type of the flow node

namespace.description: The namespace identifier for the flow node type (e.g., "port1/systems/zero/flow-nodes/agent")

nodePorts.description: List of ports used by the flow node

interfaceFlags.description: List of interface flags indicating the capabilities of the flow node

configurationSchema.description: JSON schema defining the structure and validation rules for the flow node's configuration properties
